Definition: dative case feminine of a derivative of G4228 (as adverb); foot-wise, i.e. by walking:--a- (on) foot.
BiblicalUsage: Pezei means on foot, by walking, and it appears when the crowds follow Jesus on foot. When He withdraws by ship to a desert place, the people hear of it and follow Him on foot out of the cities, and they outgo Him to the far shore.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the crowds on foot shame my comfort: they walked miles to hear Jesus, and I complain about the journey to church.
